name: Auxiliary Essence Storage Unit
description: Adds 10 Peripheral Essence per installation. Installable up to permanent Essence times (Essence x 5 at Essence 8+). Cannot be placed in an Array.

name: Man-Machine Weaving Engine
description: An adamant ring around the soulgem that initiates a known Man-Machine weaving protocol (the Alchemical analogue of Emerald/Terrestrial Circle Sorcery), shaping Essence over a few seconds. Grants 1 permanent Clarity; can never be removed and can never be placed in an Array. See the Man-Machine protocols (CH4).

name: God-Machine Weaving Engine
description: A larger adamant ring concentric to the Man-Machine Weaving Engine that initiates a known God-Machine weaving protocol (the analogue of Sapphire/Celestial Circle Sorcery), shaping Essence over two turns. Grants 1 permanent Clarity; can never be removed and can never be placed in an Array. See the God-Machine protocols (CH4).
